chunks: From him, from Ayoub ibn Nuh, from Safwan, from Salim, Abu al-Fadl, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): When a man bathes, his wife's slave-girl pours water over him and wipes him with oil. He said: 'He makes it permissible for her from his female slave.'
I said: May I be your ransom, if she makes it permissible for him, is what has passed permissible for him? He said: 'Yes.'
And regarding the man who buys a slave-girl who has a free husband, he said: 'It is not permissible for anyone to touch her until her free husband divorces her.'
We will clarify the aspect of this issue later, if God wills.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for a master to have sexual relations with a slave-girl who has a free husband?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the jurisprudence of *tamalluk* (possession) by detailing the conditions under which a master may engage in intimacy with his slave-girl, specifically addressing the validity of past acts upon her consent and the requirement of waiting for her free husband's divorce. It highlights the distinct legal status of slave-women in Shia fiqh, where their marital bond to a free spouse does not automatically preclude the master's rights until the divorce is finalized, reflecting the nuanced application of Quranic principles to the institution of concubinage.
